about: Dual-column score: picture | commentary | sound, from plan.md §5 and exposure.json. All stems start at film time 0, 44.1 kHz stereo, share one gain and sum to mix.wav.

columns.picture: The wall wakes: toned Cueva rock fades up under the charcoal bands; real stencils and guanacos come up with the light. Title 'Teuf-teuf' scratches on in white (1.2 s). The boulder sits at x0; the two cut-card figures walk in (IK walk, foot plants).
columns.sound: stone-room air; footsteps on each foot plant; scratch of the title

columns.picture: DRAG. Pusher leans 40°, hands pinned, feet planted; helper hauls the rope. Nine stick-slip lurches carry the stone 1.2 m; a nod, a ±1.5° rock and a rear-foot re-plant at each slip. Stop at 11.5 s; white ghost at 1.2 m from 11.7 s. Declared reset cut at 12.75 s.
columns.commentary: 7.3 s (4th stick) « La pierre avance d'un pas, puis elle réfléchit. » / The stone takes a step, then thinks it over.
columns.sound: palms on stone at 4.5; a stone-on-stone scrape per slip whose level and grain follow the stone's speed; silence on every stick; step per re-plant; low thud at the stop; faint scratch for the ghost; scratch stroke under the reset wipe

columns.picture: SUBSTITUTE I. The stone is levered up in 3 frames; three bark logs are shoved in; it settles on a tilt spring.
columns.sound: lever knock; three wooden knocks (13.15 / 13.35 / 13.55); soft settle thud

columns.picture: ROLLERS (wide). The stone rolls toward 1.5 m; logs turn and drift back at v/2.
columns.sound: low wooden rumble whose level and grain rate follow the carried logs' angular speed

columns.picture: TEST SHOT, close-up x2.2 oblique. Log A squeezes out behind the rear lip, rolls under the pusher's lead foot (he lifts it), and stops on its flat facet well behind the stone (16.84 s). The carrier lifts log D in the background.
columns.commentary: 17.2 s « Et moi ? » dit le rouleau qu'on laisse derrière. / "And me?" says the roller left behind. (the only nonhuman line)
columns.sound: small dry roll following log A's own angular speed; the foot re-plant; TOK and one rebound at 16.84; rumble falls to zero at 16.95; light knock as hands take log D

columns.picture: Wide again. The carrier crouches and sets log D down in front (19.7 s). The stone waits on two logs; the pusher holds.
columns.sound: carrier's steps; wood set down on stone at 19.7

columns.picture: The stone rolls on to 3.0 m, riding onto log D at 21.67 s; log A lies behind.
columns.sound: rumble returns with the logs' angular speed; short knock as the nose rides onto D; soft thud at 23.0

columns.picture: Hold. Ghost at 3.0 m (23.3 s). Declared reset cut at 25.0.

WHEEL AND AXLE. Plank platform on one axle and two GrabCut Ljubljana wheels; 8.0 m in the same 7 s push (26.0–33.0). The pusher's stride rate rises; the carrier walks alongside empty-handed and drops back. Passes the 3 m ghost at 28.38 s; ghost at 8.0 m at 33.3 s. Reset cut at 34.0.
columns.commentary: 28.8 s « La roue tourne sur place ; c'est tout le reste qui voyage. » / The wheel turns on the spot; everything else travels.
columns.sound: axle-and-wheel rumble following the wheels' angular speed; a plank knock on both wheels at each full turn (27.91, 29.33, 30.79 s); quickening footsteps; low thud as the cart halts; ghost scratch

columns.picture: COUNTER-CHECK. Pin pulled (34.6), beam lifts away; the same push (35.3). Loose wheels roll at v/2, the rear wheel runs out (36.07) and stops (36.22); the platform drops (36.30) and grinds to a stop at 0.95 m (36.83).
columns.commentary: 36.6 s « Sans essieu, la roue n'est qu'un rouleau qui se croit quelqu'un. » / Without an axle, a wheel is just a roller with ideas.
columns.sound: pin click and a light beam knock; loose-wheel rumble; heavy wood knock as the wheel falls; small tok as it stops; THUD and a stone grind that follows the platform's speed; short thud at the stop

columns.picture: COMPARISON HELD. Three ghosts (1.2 / 3.0 / 8.0 m), log A and the wheel-less platform where they fell. The figures sit; the pusher sits on log A (39.6) and it rocks once. End line scratches in at 42.0.
columns.commentary: 42.0 s end source line (French, English subtitle)
columns.sound: air; footsteps of the sit-down; final TOK of the forgotten log and its one rock back; faint scratch of the end line
